# Native O3 eta n1 core source: accepted conditional local RHS DATA

This publication records the canonical local n1 forcing source only. It registers the old-core eta view conditionally and does not install a regular n1 solution or materialize n1 values.

The g4/g5/g6 rows are inhomogeneities of the n1 coefficient equations, not an externally chosen Navier–Stokes body force and not a full Navier–Stokes validation.

Scope: rho in [0,4], eta in [-1,1], ordinary Z derivatives at fixed rho. There is no 4.1 splice and no tau field.

Units: g4 = 2 sqrt(rho) Psrc, g5 = 2 Tsrc with a positive formal F0 anchor coefficient, and g6 = 2 Zsrc - 4 epsilon Z rho Psrc / L. No extra Pstar, sqrt(2), or half factor is inserted.

The exact view is conditional on the declared old/common source and uniqueness theorem. p0_chart and I_candidate remain envelopes, not exact functions. Picard index 1 is not temporal n1.
